actual_summary.scope: Passive complete saved-file joins and literal word-dictionary display decoding; no scientific Source execution/replay. Unqualified aggregate counts include two explicitly NONADMITTED failed attempts; separate admitted counts follow.

assessment: The explicit full-word carrier passed its actual independent construction checks. In the one resource-admitted job, both point arms finished their two exhaustive domain/inverse/scheduler audits, restored the original state/Graph exactly, and made 4 and 10 actual placement attempts. D7 made no point placements. This is concrete implementation progress under the unchanged local clock, not proof-search superiority.

All six point calls returned positive placement counts and two complete audits, totalling 89 observed placements and 12 audits. Only 14 placements and 4 audits belong to the resource-admitted case. The remaining observations are retained for diagnosis, never promoted into a qualified comparison.

The first positive attempt failed the worker combined-memory gate; its Python and Native peaks alone sum to 1,079,541,760 bytes, above the 1 GiB ceiling. The equality attempt returned a complete child packet but failed whole custody, with conservative peak 1,153,777,664 bytes. The missing-premise job passed at 860,045,312 bytes. No cap is raised and no failed prefix is adopted.

S0 again produced the 14-line positive certificate, with accepted Host/region/Native records. Its whole case failed memory, so this is a nonadmitted saved observation. The earlier D7 S0 proof remains separately admitted; no new admitted recipient theorem was found here.

Each P10 call has 12 certified initial exclusions. Initial complete Graph audits show 12 fewer incidences than the corresponding P00 initial audit. In the admitted negative job this demonstrates actual Graph pruning, rather than merely a post-search conflict scan. It does not establish useful tree reduction: both point searches remain budget-unknown, and the attempt counts depend on a short cooperative clock.

The 48 new reference controls returned in each packet. Only the controls in the one whole-admitted job count as qualified evidence for this stage. All cluster-dependent arms were explicitly skipped after unknown Native admission: nine observed skips, of which three belong to the admitted job. There was no trained RL policy.

The next practical problem is peak memory and end-to-end cost. Full words/metadata/evidence and proof traces remain potentially expensive. No phase-memory instrumentation was collected, so a particular allocation cannot be named as the measured cause. Any repair needs a separately declared cold experiment and the same acceptance gates.

These authored development cases do not test the strongest ATP methods or constitute a blind benchmark. Full PA, symbolic Hilbert geometry, a physical universal Wang system, learned hierarchical cluster proposals and practical Turtle/Penrose tiling remain active objectives.
